attack: Strongest opposite-NZD claim is dollar-king, trend-follower and perma-bear treating NZDUSD's 1m -3.90% plus unemployment 5.6% and the Fed/BoJ/energy overlay as a live NZD-down continuation, so fading AUDNZD is fighting trend. That claim is not owned and is internally inconsistent. Dollar-king calls NZDUSD already-washed then still tags NZD lower; if the wash is done, the residual is AUDNZD at 1.2468 (5y percentile 99.96, z 3.12, +4.27% 1m), not another NZDUSD down-leg, and short AUDUSD (0.7120, 5y 84.3rd, +0.20% 1m, copper residual z -1.33) does not own NZD. Trend-follower pays US 2Y and keeps USDCAD as the spot candidate; paying 4.76% after a delivered, previously >90% priced hike does not require NZD lower, and stretch is not a fade applies only where price/policy/revisions align. AUDNZD is two-way: AU housing/labor biting versus a NZD that cheapened through a Q2 GDP beat and an India FTA covering about 95% of NZ exports. Perma-bear receives AU 2Y; AU housing does not imply NZD down when NZ activity is 52.0 vs AU 49.2 and NZ inflation is 51.6 vs AU 49.2. Fed/BoJ/energy are common USD factors that contaminate USD pairs; they cannot double as a NZ-owned bear case. Cross-merchant is same-direction, wrong instrument: unbounded AUDNZD spot, stop null, 2-6 week clock, while its own risks are NZ labor 5.6%, missing NZ 2Y/carry, and no positioning. Perma-bull tags NZD_UP then refuses long NZDUSD and parks the view in US 2s10s at 25bp (1y percentile 0.2%, 5y percentile 54%), which owns neither NZD nor AUDNZD.
defense: Keep the Round 1 1-3m AUDNZD put spread. It is not a naked long NZDUSD and does not need the NZD-down camp to be wrong on USD. Equivalent delta is short AUD / long NZD with known debit on the only G10 FX print that is actually a 5y extreme. Continuation risk is already the reason not to use spot: NZ labor 47.0 / unemployment 5.6%, unknown AUDNZD carry (rates:NZ HTTP 403), energy/G10 tightening that can hit the higher-RV currency, and pos:unavailable. A cash short has unbounded left tail if NZD keeps cheapening; a cash long buys the 99.96th percentile. The put spread waits for the two-way event window without inventing a reversion clock or a strike. Implied vol, 25d risk-reversal and fly remain unquoted; do not execute until a live screen shows the premium is not already pricing the unwind versus sourced 20d realized 5.09% (AUDNZD) and 6.31% (NZDUSD). Concede the NZD-down camp if NZ labor/activity confirm the unemployment channel over the GDP beat/FTA and AUDNZD makes a new extreme while AU housing/labor stop deteriorating. Concede the expression, not necessarily the macro, if live implied and 25d RR already fully price that unwind. Do not roll the debit into spot. Unknowns unchanged: NZ 2Y, AUDNZD carry, Cot/flow, executable option prices.
holes_in_opposing_case: Dollar-king's NZD_DOWN contradicts its own already-washed NZDUSD claim. If the 1m -3.90% (5y percentile 8.61, z -1.15) is completed wash, the live stretch is AUDNZD at 1.2468, 5y percentile 99.96, z 3.12 after +4.27% 1m, not another NZDUSD down-leg. Short AUDUSD (0.7120, 5y 84.3rd, +0.20% 1m, copper residual z -1.33) is a USD-laggard story; invalidation never tests NZ data, so NZD_DOWN is unused overlay.

Trend-follower tags NZD_DOWN but pays US 2Y (4.76%, +57bp 1m) and keeps USDCAD as the spot candidate. Paying US 2Y does not require NZD lower. Stretch is not a fade is a valid US-front-end argument only where price, delivered Fed hike, and inflation revisions align; it is not a license to treat two-way AUDNZD event risk as a NZD continuation that must be ridden.

Perma-bear's NZD_DOWN is unused: the trade is receive AU 2Y. AU housing (stamp duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, prices more than 7% off peak) and AU labor 47.8 support AUD-down, not NZD-down. Packet NZ gauges run the other way: activity 52.0 vs AU 49.2, inflation 51.6 vs AU 49.2, Q2 GDP +0.2% q/q beat, India FTA covering about 95% of NZ exports. Labor 47.0 / unemployment 5.6% is an offset, not a completed NZ bear case.

None of the NZD-down camp produces a NZ-owned catalyst that NZD must keep cheapening through more constructive NZ news. Fed 25bp to 3.75-4.00%, BoJ to 1.25%, and energy (Brent 130.8, 99.6th percentile) are common USD/G10 factors. Those factors contaminate USD pairs; they are why AUDNZD was built from NZDUSD -3.90% versus AUDUSD +0.20%, not evidence the cross extreme must extend.

Cross-merchant agrees AUDNZD short / NZD up but expresses it as unbounded spot with stop null on a 2-6 week clock while listing NZ labor 5.6%, missing NZ 2Y/carry (rates:NZ unavailable), and pos:unavailable as principal risks. Those packet gaps are why a defined-risk 1-3m put spread dominates cash, not why to sit short the cross.

Perma-bull tags NZD_UP then refuses long NZDUSD (unavailable NZ yields, labor 47.0) and parks the view in US 2s10s at 25bp (1y percentile 0.2%; 5y percentile 54%). That does not own NZD or AUDNZD. Treating the NZ GDP beat as global cyclical confirmation for a US curve is a category error versus the Pacific FX discrepancy.

NZ data or RBNZ communication that re-anchors NZD after the Q2 GDP beat and India trade implementation, reversing the 1m NZDUSD slide that built the cross extreme.
Energy/G10 tightening event risk that lifts FX implied from a still-unobserved base; only then is vol itself the P&L, and only if the live screen confirms it was not already priced.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: AU 10Y outright (5.348, 1y 99th percentile as of 2026-09-16) or AU-NZ 2Y RV; the NZ leg is not executable because official NZ sovereign yields are unavailable (HTTP 403) and AUDNZD vs AU-NZ 2Y is status insufficient.
expression_comparison.rationale: The discrepancy lives in the AUDNZD distribution and in two-way NZ/AU event risk, not in a clean AU duration or AU-NZ curve view. Rates cannot own the NZ side: rates:NZ is unavailable and xa:opportunities marks AUDNZD carry and AUDNZD~AU-NZ_2Y as unavailable/insufficient. Spot short AUDNZD fights an unknown carry and has unbounded risk if NZD labor weakness (unemployment 5.6%) extends the 1m -3.90% NZDUSD slide. A 1-3m put spread bounds premium, keeps the short-AUD/long-NZD delta, and does not require inventing a reversion clock. Do not substitute an AUDUSD or AUDCAD spot short: AUDUSD is only 84th percentile and has lagged copper (residual z -1.33); AUDCAD is also 99.96th percentile but 2Y carry of 165bp / 60d vol 4.93 explicitly compensates a spot fade, whereas AUDNZD carry cannot even be measured.
expression_comparison.spot_candidate: Short AUDNZD cash at ECB reference 1.2468 (research/reference only, not executable).

revised_trade.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if AUDNZD extends to a new extreme while AU housing/labor stop deteriorating and NZ activity/inflation fail to support NZD, or if a live broker screen shows AUDNZD implied vol and 25d risk-reversal already fully pricing the unwind versus sourced 20d realized 5.09% (AUDNZD) and 6.31% (NZDUSD). Right-thesis/wrong-timing if the mechanism is intact but the option decays through the 1-3m window without a catalyst; reassess rather than rolling into spot.
revised_trade.mispricing: Market pricing in the frozen packet is the AUDNZD level itself at a 5y extreme (percentile 99.96, z 3.12) after NZDUSD sold 3.90% in a month through a GDP beat and a trade-deal headline, while AU housing and AU labor are already showing the tightening channel. That is a fundamentals-versus-distribution and market-versus-market discrepancy (AUDUSD not equivalently stretched; AUDUSD vs copper residual z -1.33). It is not an implied-versus-realized claim: FX implied vol and skew are missing. Do not treat the z-score as a mean-reversion signal; it is the historical reference that makes a bounded option the cleaner way to wait for a catalyst.
principal_risks: NZD labor is the weakest of the four (unemployment 5.6%); a spot-like continuation in NZDUSD can grind through a put spread if implied was not cheap.
Implied vol, skew and fly are unknown; the structure can be a negative-carry debit if AUDNZD implied is already rich to 20d realized 5.09%.
AUDNZD carry cannot be measured; if the missing NZ 2Y later shows a large AUD yield advantage, theta works against the short cross.
No positioning/flow dataset: a crowded NZD short squeeze or AUD long liquidation cannot be distinguished from macro.
Global energy shock and higher-for-longer US yields can hit NZD as the higher-RV, weaker-percentile currency, extending AUDNZD.
ECB FX prints are research/reference only; executable spot and option markets can differ.
revised_trade.structure: Defined-risk 1-3 month AUDNZD put spread: buy a closer-to-spot AUDNZD put, sell a further out-of-the-money put. Equivalent delta is short AUD / long NZD with known debit. No strike, delta, premium, implied vol or risk-reversal quote is sourced in this packet; those must be taken from a live broker screen before execution. If 25d risk-reversal already prices NZD upside versus 20d realized 5.09% (AUDNZD) and 6.31% (NZDUSD), shrink size or stand down rather than inventing a cheapness claim.
revised_trade.thesis: FACT: On 2026-09-18 ECB same-fixing research crosses, AUDNZD spot is 1.2468, 5y percentile 99.96, z 3.12, 1m return +4.27%, 20d realized vol 5.09%. The same snapshot has NZDUSD at 0.5711, 5y percentile 8.61, z -1.15, 1m -3.90%, 20d RV 6.31%, versus AUDUSD 0.7120, 5y percentile 84.3, z 1.23, 1m only +0.20%, 20d RV 4.71%. So the cross extreme is mostly NZD underperformance, not an AUD melt-up. AU 10Y is 5.348 (1y percentile 99.0, 1m +26bp) with NSW stamp-duty receipts -24% y/y and Sydney/Melbourne home values more than 7% off peak; AU labor temperature is 47.8 (unemployment 4.5%, employment -15.8k m/m). NZ Q2 GDP printed +0.2% q/q but beat forecasts; NZ inflation temperature is 51.6; NZ labor is 47.0 with unemployment 5.6%; parliament passed an India trade deal covering about 95% of NZ exports to India. Official NZ yields are unavailable, so AUDNZD carry and AU-NZ 2Y RV are not in the packet. Equity VIX is 15.44 (percentile 14.7, z -0.84) while Brent is 130.8 (percentile 99.6) and WTI 107.02 (percentile 96.4); USDJPY 20d RV is 11.04 after a +1.41% 1d rally on the BoJ hike to 1.25%. Positioning/flow is unavailable. Executable option prices are not in the packet. INFERENCE: Spot is the wrong expression because the closing mechanism (AU housing/labor biting versus a sold-off NZD that just beat GDP) has unknown timing and two-way event risk; a cash short is an unbounded bet that NZD cannot cheapen further, and a cash long is buying a 5y extreme. The put spread owns the same AUD-down/NZD-up discrepancy with defined debit. Cross-asset, suppressed VIX against an energy and G10-tightening regime is a reason to worry that event risk is underpriced in vol markets we can observe, but that is equity vol not AUDNZD implied and is not a substitute for a live FX vol screen. UNKNOWN: AUDNZD implied vol, 25d risk reversal, fly, forward points, and NZ 2Y. Cot/positioning. Whether the NZD slide is flow/liquidation rather than macro (no plumbing dataset).
why_now: AUDNZD prints the packet's most extreme G10 FX percentile (99.96) and z (3.12) on the 2026-09-18 snapshot, with the 1m move already +4.27%.

The Fed 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% was >90% priced and is now known information; the live relative impulse is AU housing/labor versus a NZD that cheapened through a Q2 GDP beat and the India trade law — a two-way event window, not a drift that spot can sit on.
AU-NZ rate RV and AUDNZD carry remain untradeable while NZ yields stay unavailable, so waiting for a rates expression abandons the FX discrepancy.

VIX at 15.44 (14.7th percentile) versus Brent at the 99.6th percentile and USDJPY 20d RV 11% is the observable vol-regime warning; FX implied is still unchecked and must be checked before paying premium.
